exposure: Women with seizures within 6 months of conception
cohort: 148 pregnant women with epilepsy and 1480 pregnant women without epilepsy
finding: Pregnancies involving women with epilepsy were associated with higher rates of spontaneous abortion, preterm birth, low birth weight, and caesarean section compared to pregnancies without epilepsy.
mod_finding: Caesarean section rates were higher in pregnancies involving women with epilepsy compared to pregnancies without epilepsy.
